explication: Scratch GUI is a React interface for creating and running Scratch 3.0 projects. The user-facing workflow enters the editor, presents project controls and visual programming tools, and runs the project through the Scratch VM. The map also preserves asset editing and libraries, tutorials, cloud support, and state management. The README and excerpts establish the main UI and several integrations; unsampled subsystems are represented only where the tree and source index support them, so some connections are intentionally omitted.
